name: Zinc Methionine 25 mg
headline: Zinc Methionine 25 mg
description: A bioavailable source of zinc as a chelated compound of zinc with the amino acid methionine, 25 mg of elemental zinc per capsule. It helps strengthen immunity, supports the health and beauty of skin, hair and nails and helps slow early ageing.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
